question: Why does it feel like I can't catch a break lately?
answer: Two systems are active at once, which is why it reads as relentless instead of one hard week. Transiting Saturn is conjunct your natal Mercury within a third of a degree, separating — and Mercury is your Lord of the Year this cycle, ruling the Gemini profection activated at age thirty-four. When Saturn crosses the year's ruling planet, the lesson isn't punishment, it's structure: whatever discipline you build under this pressure holds past the transit itself. At the same time, transiting Pluto is closely opposite your natal Moon in Leo, just past your Ascendant — that's the part that feels personal, old emotional weather resurfacing uninvited rather than an external circumstance. Separately, either signal would be background noise. Together — and with your natal Mars already sitting conjunct Saturn in Aquarius in the seventh — they're compounding rather than coinciding. The practical takeaway: don't make irreversible relationship decisions until the Pluto-Moon opposition widens past a two-degree orb, which clears by late October. Read this season, don't react to it.
